description: Fantastic Fist is a 2D platformer which uses both keyboard and mouse controls.

V0.0.1.description:
The first revision of the Fantastic Fist AP World has been created!
Due to the structure of the game (high progression percentage) it is easy to get generation errors when playing solo.
V0.0.1.title: Fantastic Fist AP World V0.0.1

V0.0.2.description:
The first full release of Fantastic Fist Archipelago!
Coins, goal blocks, tutorial pages, and boss hits as locations, and level gimmicks and coins as items.

Currently Deathlink, Roomsanity, Checkpointsanity, Entrance Rando, and Door Rando do not work. They will be implemented at a later date.
V0.0.2.title: Fantastic Fist Archipelago V0.0.2

V0.0.3.description:
Entrance Rando has been implemented.
Fixed versioning of the mod and AP World.
Fixed bug where multiple connection sessions could be stored.
Info tabs when hovering over a level now correctly show what exits have been collected in the level.
Boss info tabs will show how many coins are acquired and needed when the player does not have enough.
Fixed generation bug in the AP World when using Entrance Rando but no Door Rando.

Currently Deathlink, Roomsanity, Checkpointsanity, and Door Rando do not work. They will be implemented at a later date.
V0.0.3.title: Fantastic Fist Archipelago V0.0.3

V0.0.4.description:
Fixed an issue in the rules in the AP World that would cause gen fails on glitched difficulty.
Fixed an issue where trying to move the whoop transition upon starting after quitting in W3 would throw a null reference exception.

Currently Deathlink, Roomsanity, Checkpointsanity, and Door Rando do not work. They will be implemented at a later date.
V0.0.4.title: Fantastic Fist Archipelago V0.0.4
